_comment: Paths that were published, are gone, and must stay gone.
ONE source of truth, read by three consumers, because the defect being
fixed here was exactly a path that was deleted in one place and kept
alive in two others. public/_redirects turns each of these into a real
404; scripts/build-sitemap.mjs refuses to list them; the IndexNow list is
derived from that sitemap, so it cannot resubmit them either.
tests/sitemap.test.ts asserts every entry here has a matching rule in
public/_redirects, so the two files cannot drift apart silently.

retired.reason: HVAC business identification page is consumer attack-surface SEO. Removed; not a court-record surface.
Characterisation slug (PR #7). Stays 404; do not 301.
Third-party characterisation page about a non-party. Deleted in PR #7. Not to be confused with /retractions/rob-hein/, which is a live page about a served retraction demand.

Withdrawn from the site on Conrad's instruction, 2026-07-31. The exhibit is a completed application form, and a labelled field on it carried protected personal identifying information of the kind MCR 1.109(D)(9) keeps out of a public filing. The document, its PDF and its extracted text were removed together: a partial removal leaves the same text served from another surface. Withdrawn from the site, not from the court record.

The divorce filings reference the PPO case only in seeking its dismissal, and that argument is published in full; the PPO record itself is published by the opposing party elsewhere, so this site's copy added nothing to the public record. Scope, not selection: inside the published cases everything publishes on the same terms.
